name: Coffee-Rubbed Slow Cooker Pork Shoulder
why: Verified from source page: 588 cal / 46.55g protein / 20.52g carbs per serving - squarely in the 400-650 cal, <=35g carb band. Slow-cooker whole pork shoulder shredded, weigh-and-divide friendly, trivially scales to 14. Distinct coffee-and-brown-sugar rub concept not present in the catalog's Latin/BBQ pork set. Every ingredient maps to the Omaha board (pork-shoulder, coffee, brown-sugar, cayenne-pepper, paprika, garlic, salt, black-pepper) - no unmapped signature ingredient.
